case.selection_note: One observed protein chain with associated molecules retained by existing application selection; this does not assert a biological monomer.

warnings: Selecting one observed protein chain does not establish that it is the biological monomer. The largest observed chain is suggested; sequence groups compare observed residue names only.

notes: One observed protein chain was selected; this is not a biological-assembly or monomer assignment.

Associated molecules are retained whole when covalently attached or when any heavy atom is within 5 Å of the selected chain in the first source frame. This proximity rule does not establish biological binding.
Ordinary solvent and the previous periodic box are excluded. Observed coordinating waters of retained monatomic metals are retained. Prepare the derived structure and create its solvent box again.

gaps.message: Backbone C–N separation is 8.48 Å; this connection requires repair before force-field preparation.

warnings: Ligands are retained with their bound heavy-atom coordinates. Preparation assigns a recorded fixed protonation state and GAFF2 / AM1-BCC parameters for explicit-water OpenMM dynamics.
Retained ions use declared monatomic charge states and require explicit TIP3P water; coordination energetics and alternate oxidation states are not modeled.

Missing sequence-supported residues are listed. Rebuilding internal gaps is opt-in and produces provisional coordinates; longer loops have greater conformational uncertainty. Geometry checks do not establish the native loop conformation.
A long backbone connection is present. Unresolved internal gaps must be repaired before force-field preparation or simulation; a stretched inferred peptide bond is not accepted.
Missing terminal sequence is reported but not rebuilt. The observed structure is prepared as a truncated chain with terminal groups.
pH assignment uses OpenMM template/heuristic protonation and histidine tautomer rules, not a pKa calculation or constant-pH simulation.

ligands.protonation_method: Dimorphite-DL 2 empirical site rules at requested pH, pKa precision=0; amide/N–N sites retained from source; original graph/stereotags preserved; no microscopic pKa or tautomer ranking
warnings: Ligand protonation is a fixed model choice; it is not a binding-site pKa calculation or a tautomer ranking. A missing protonation-tool atom map was restored by a unique element/connectivity match constrained by all retained maps.
ligands.stereo_limitations: Carbon tetrahedral CCD/input-SMILES configurations are checked. Nitrogen inversion, atropisomerism, and phosphorus stereodescriptors after ionization are not validated; the original bound heavy-atom pose is retained.
